purpose: Measure provider-format completion and Imp content/reasoning mapping on one synthetic typed output. This is not an optimizer, benchmark, or held-out-label campaign.

synthetic_case.instructions: Return the only allowed status for this synthetic format canary.

catalog_observation.selection_rule: Exact :free ID with zero prompt/completion catalog pricing and advertised response_format support; prefer advertised structured_outputs and a non-mandatory reasoning route, plus the closed V2 route under a larger format-only envelope.

candidates.rationale: Exact-free instruction model advertising native schema support with reasoning disabled by default in the pinned local registry.
Compact exact-free text model advertising native schema support; useful independent format route.
Same exact-free route as closed V2, but a format-only canary with forced schema, low reasoning effort, and a defensible 2x output envelope.

required_response_evidence: content digest and bounded redacted excerpt
native reasoning presence, digest, bounded redacted excerpt, and byte count
typed adapter result or structured adapter error
success_rule: Exactly one logical and transport attempt returns status=ok, finish_reason=stop, non-empty typed content, explicit zero cost, and no route or request drift.
claim_limits: Format completion does not measure optimizer effectiveness or task quality.
No support-ticket test input or label may be used.
A successful canary may inform a separate V3 preregistration but cannot launch or admit V3.
